description: Replace the monitor's webhook signing secret and return the new webhook_secret, shown only here. Free. Deliveries from now on are signed with it, and the old secret no longer verifies them: update your endpoint before the next run. 400 when the monitor has no webhook.

monitor_id.description: monitor_id returned by monitor-create or monitor-list, example: '6f1d0c9e-0d55-4b8e-9a3c-3c4d9b8e2a10'.

name: monitor-webhook-rotate-secret
title: Rotate Monitor Webhook Secret
